Subject: Follow-up + proposed times for technical deep dive / demo

Hi Alex and Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme Analytics is looking to standardize LLM inference for your customer-facing summarization feature, prioritize sub-100ms tail latency for 8k context, and achieve a predictable cost profile across regions.

Next step: technical deep dive + demo (30–45 minutes) with our solutions engineer to walk through architecture, perf profiles, and integration patterns. Proposed times next week (all PT):
- Tue, Apr 20 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed, Apr 21 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT
- Thu, Apr 22 — 11:00–11:45 AM PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (security, infra, PM)? We’ll include Camila (AE) and Rafael (SE) on the invite.

I attached a short agenda for the call and a checklist of what we’ll demo. If your security lead wants a separate pre-call, note that in your reply and we’ll set up a short session.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf
